blocks.text: Dondon Hontiveros earned his second coaching victory in the Cesafi as the University of Cebu Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) Webmasters routed the University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons, 70-47, in the Season 26 men’s basketball tournament at the Cebu Coliseum on Saturday, October 17....
